verdict.rationale: Gram documents discovering and importing official third-party MCP servers from a catalog powered by the official MCP Registry. Admins can also find and add MCP servers from their MCP client, so the browse-and-discover core is first-party. The docs do not show search or filtering by capability, the catalog's size, or tool-level browsing before import. Missing for 10: documented search/filter by capability, evidence of catalog size and tool-level browsing, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search and browse a large catalog of MCP servers and tools by capability before wiring anything into my agent
